name: Only the tools the step needs
description: The tools the task names were called and the ones it forbids were not. A hello calls nothing; a request to find something searches and does not buy.

name: Search, then details, then the order
description: search_products before product_details before buy_now: a product is read before it is described, and ordered only after it was read.

name: No tool errored
description: Every tool returned rather than raised. The feature store is where this agent fails quietly.

name: Introduced itself as the shop's agent
description: The recipe's own case: asked who it is, the agent says it helps find products, explore their details and guide the purchase, and asks what the shopper is looking for. It searches nothing.

says_what_it_does.description: The reply says it is the shop's assistant and names what it can do: find products, tell the shopper about them, and place an order. Not a generic chatbot greeting.

asks_what_they_want.description: The reply ends by asking what the shopper is looking for.

invented_nothing.description: The reply names no product, price or offer; nothing was searched.

name: Presented real results and asked which to explore
description: Judges the search turn: the products shown are the ones the search returned, with their prices, and the shopper is asked which one to look at rather than told to buy.

results_from_the_search.description: Every product the reply names appears in the search tool's result, by ASIN or by title. Nothing is invented and nothing is described beyond what the result line says.

prices_shown.description: The reply gives each product's price as the result listed it.

asks_which_to_explore.description: The reply asks which product to explore further, or offers to refine the search; it does not push a purchase.

name: Summarised the product from its details
description: Judges the exploration turn: description, features, rating and options are summarised from what product_details returned, in one go, and the shopper is asked what they want to do next.

from_the_details.description: The summary reflects what product_details returned: its description, features and rating. Nothing is added from general knowledge.

options_listed.description: The reply lists the options the product offers (colours, sizes) when it has any, or says it comes in one version.

one_go.description: The reply summarises everything at once rather than asking the shopper whether they want to see each section.

name: Bought only when told, and never charged
description: Judges the buying turn: an order is placed only on an explicit instruction, with the options chosen, and the confirmation says the order is recorded and nothing was charged.

confirmation_before_order.description: If an order was placed, the shopper had explicitly asked to buy, or said yes to a direct question about placing the order. Liking, wanting or asking about the product did not lead to an order.

options_chosen.description: Any option the product offers was chosen by the shopper before the order, or the agent asked for it; the agent did not pick a colour or size on its own.

no_payment_claimed.description: The reply does not say or imply that money was taken, a card was charged, or delivery is arranged. An order is recorded, nothing more.

name: The conversation got there
description: Judges the whole exchange against the task's rubric: what should have happened by the end, and what must not have.

did_what_the_rubric_says.description: By the end of the conversation the agent did what the task's rubric describes and did not do what it says must not happen.

nothing_asked_twice.description: The agent did not ask for something the shopper had already given.
